login.title: Welcome to Naqla
login.hint: Sign in to manage your store

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.sub: Sales in Muscat time; canceled orders excluded

tokens.deleted: Deleted (falls back to the technical setup)

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp templates
whatsapp.sub: Sign-in code and order-stage notifications — sent only after the template is approved by Meta and its name is linked
whatsapp.devMode: Development mode: written to the log
whatsapp.otpPreview: Text generated automatically by Meta with a “Copy code” button
whatsapp.arabicOnly: The merchant alert is always in Arabic — no English version

support.title: Support from Naqla
support.sub: We're here to help you run your store
support.waText: Hello Naqla, I need technical support for the store {{name}} ({{slug}})

loyalty.title: Loyalty
loyalty.sub: Points stay pending until delivery, then become available to redeem; the tier comes from confirmed points
loyalty.tiersOff: Tiers are turned off for this store.
loyalty.contact: To change the rules, tiers or perks, contact the Naqla team.

tracking.title: Tracking tools
tracking.sub: Stored on the server. The browser loads a pixel only if its ID is set and the visitor consents; purchases and deliveries are also sent from the server with the same event_id.
tracking.saveFirst: Save the settings before testing. The test button sends a test event from the server and shows the platform's response as is.
tracking.savedSecret: Saved — type a new value to replace it
tracking.testActive_one: ⚠ Test mode is on for real events — ends in {{count}} hour
tracking.testActive_other: ⚠ Test mode is on for real events — ends in {{count}} hours
tracking.testExpired: Expired for real events — test button only
tracking.accepted: ✓ The event arrived and the platform accepted it
tracking.rejected: ✗ The request arrived and the platform rejected it

hints.meta_test_event_code: From Events Manager → Test events (remove it after testing)

toggles.snap_test_mode: Validation mode (validate) — events are not actually recorded

notes.ga4: Tested through Google's debug validation endpoint: “validationMessages: []” means the event is well formed.
notes.meta: With test_event_code, events show in the Test events window and do not count toward campaigns.
notes.snap: Snap does not use test_event_code; validation mode returns the check result without recording the event.
notes.tiktok: With test_event_code, events show in Test events.
notes.clarity: Runs in the browser only (session recordings and heatmaps) — nothing is sent from the server.

seo.title: SEO (search engines)
seo.redirectAfter: ” will redirect (301) to the new one automatically
seo.savedRedirect: Saved — a 301 redirect was created from the old handle

delivery.title: Delivery details
delivery.giftNote: Gift order — premium wrapping and a card, no invoice inside the parcel
delivery.contactForMeasures: Contact the customer to take the measurements

translation.title: English translation
translation.allDone: All product fields and options are translated. The product shows in English on /en.
translation.howTo: Anything without a translation shows in Arabic on the English storefront. Add translations from “Translations” or from locales/en.json, then run pnpm i18n:sync.

untranslated.count: {{n}} of {{count}} products have no English title:

settings.title: Store settings
settings.sub: What you save here shows in your store within seconds; a value equal to the default restores it.
settings.savedLive: Saved ({{n}}) — live in the store within seconds
settings.savedSecrets: Saved ({{n}}) — keys are encrypted and hidden
settings.offDays: Days off (no express delivery or delivery slots)
settings.secretsNote: Keys are stored encrypted and only their last 4 characters show after saving. Leave a field empty to keep the current value.
settings.needsLoyalty: Requires loyalty to be turned on first
settings.voiceNote: Voice applies to the Arabic storefront only (English has no gendered forms); the examples are Arabic storefront text.

uploaded.logo: Logo uploaded ({{n}}) — live in the store within seconds
uploaded.icon: Icon uploaded ({{n}}) — live in the store within seconds

settings.customIdentity: The custom identity stays as Naqla designed it

fields.features_gift: Send the order as a gift
fields.name: Store name
fields.brand_wordmark: The logo contains the full store name

hints.languages: Shows the language switcher and /en links in the store
hints.defaultLanguage: Where the store's root link goes, x-default in hreflang, and the notification language when an order has none — Arabic links never get a prefix
hints.features_thawani: Requires Thawani keys in the Payments & messaging tab
hints.features_reviews: Keep it off until a real review system is available
hints.features_bnpl: Shows only if the provider supports the store currency
hints.legal_cr: Shows in the footer and policy pages
hints.reservationHours_whatsapp: An unconfirmed order is canceled after this and its stock released
hints.shortName: Shows on mobile and the app icon
hints.description: For search engines and link sharing
hints.brand_logo: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5MB — resized automatically
hints.brand_wordmark: Off: a square mark next to the short name
hints.icons_icon512: Square, at least 192×192 — mobile and browser icons are generated from it
hints.merchantPhones: Up to 5 numbers with country code; each gets a WhatsApp message for every new order

errors.field_angle: {{field}}: the characters < and > are not allowed
errors.field_phone: {{field}}: digits only (8–15) with the country code
errors.image_upload_only: Images are uploaded with the upload button in the Identity tab
errors.languages_invalid: Languages: Arabic is required, English is optional
errors.offdays_invalid: Days off: weekdays 0–6, keeping at least one working day
errors.merchant_phones_list: Merchant numbers: a list of numbers
errors.merchant_phones_format: Merchant numbers: digits only (8–15) with the country code
errors.vat_format: VAT number format: OM followed by 10 digits
errors.key_not_editable: The key “{{key}}” can't be edited from the dashboard
errors.db_required: A database connection is required to save
errors.tiers_need_loyalty: Tiers require loyalty to be turned on first
errors.payment_required: Turn on at least one payment method
errors.default_language_disabled: The default language must be one of the enabled languages
errors.thawani_need_keys: Thawani needs its keys first — enter them in the Payments & messaging tab
errors.thawani_secret_format: Thawani secret key: letters and digits without spaces
errors.thawani_publishable_format: Thawani publishable key: letters and digits without spaces
errors.free_over_gt_amount: The free delivery threshold must be greater than the delivery price
errors.express_province_required: Choose at least one governorate for express delivery, or turn it off in Features
errors.image_too_large: The image is larger than 5 MB
errors.image_type: The image must be PNG, JPEG or WebP (not SVG)
errors.logo_too_small: The logo is too small — at least 64 pixels
errors.icon_too_small: The icon is too small — at least 192×192 pixels
errors.icon_not_square: The icon must be roughly square
errors.whatsapp_keys_missing: The access token or phone number ID is not set
errors.seo_handle_format: Handle: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens only
errors.tracking_no_pixel: No Pixel ID or access token
errors.tracking_no_ga4: No Measurement ID or API secret
